communications.body: Card-present restaurant transaction. The cardholder signed a receipt with the itemized subtotal of $85.00 and added a handwritten tip of $17.00 (20%), bringing the total to $102.00. The signed receipt clearly shows the cardholder's handwriting for the tip amount and the final total. The cardholder called [4 days after dining] but the follow-up call was missed by staff.
